events.title: Tupac Shakur: 30 Years On
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, influential rapper Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in Las Vegas, aged 25.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty years since his untimely death, Tupac's music and message still resonate. What's your favourite track from the legend?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix Anniversary
events.blurb: The music world remembers guitar legend Jimi Hendrix, who passed away in 1970 and would have been 84 this year.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Jimi Hendrix: a true innovator who redefined the electric guitar. His influence is still felt today. Which of his tracks is your go-to?

events.title: Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Iconic
angles.copy: That iconic zebra crossing, those timeless tracks. The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' turns another year older today. What's your favourite moment from the album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Hynde's Enduring Voice
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Her voice and attitude with The Pretenders have been shaping rock for decades. What's your top Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Our Kid's Birthday
angles.copy: Our Kid turns 54 today! Love him or… well, you know. What's your favourite Liam Gallagher moment, with Oasis or solo?

events.title: Imagine Album Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's seminal album 'Imagine' was released in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: More than just a song, 'Imagine' is a timeless anthem for peace. John Lennon's iconic album was released today. What does the track mean to you?

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the revolutionary first-generation iPod in 2001, changing how we listen to music forever.

angles.name: iPod Revolution
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? Today marks the anniversary of the original iPod launch. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Celebrating the iconic British secret agent, James Bond, on this special day.

angles.name: Your Favourite Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From the gadgets to the theme tunes, what's your favourite Bond film or who's your ultimate 007?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The music world remembers John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: Remembering the visionary John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Genius Cleese
angles.copy: From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, John Cleese has given us countless laughs. Wishing him a very happy 87th birthday! What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, famously known as 'The White Album', in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Diversity
angles.copy: An eclectic masterpiece! The Beatles' 'White Album' dropped today. So many styles, so many songs. Which track stands out most for you?

events.title: Freddie Mercury Anniversary
events.blurb: The music world remembers Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away in 1991 and would have been 80 this year.

angles.name: Freddie's Unforgettable Voice
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury. His voice, his stage presence – truly iconic. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential album 'Rubber Soul' in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul's Influence
angles.copy: A pivotal moment in music history! The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' was released today, marking a shift in their sound. What's your favourite track from this classic?
